metadata.article_title: Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 187.

article.title: Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 187.
article.content:
452Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 187.

Section 452  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 538 of the Act
The Assessing Officer may impose on a person, a penalty of Rs. 5000 for every day of the duration of failure where he fails to provide a facility for accepting payments through the prescribed electronic modes of payment, as referred to in section 187.
